describe: The image shows a dense carpet of small dark-green ivy leaves covering the whole surface, with lighter green highlights on the leaf tips. Scattered among them are a few orange-brown and rust-red dried fallen leaves, plus thin brown twigs in places. The leaves are small, about 2 to 3 cm each at the scale of the texture, and overlap irregularly with no regular pattern. Lighting is even and dim, with low to medium contrast and dark shadowed gaps between leaves.
